The tpcds_obt converter is classified by an owner decision recorded here; either its allowlist entry carries a reviewed reason or the generic parts move to the fork.

description: After D1, benchbox/core/flightdata/queries.py and benchbox/core/tpcds_obt/query_conversion.py stay in the bypass-test allowlist (ast_rewrite). flightdata: one-argument ROUND(double) rounds half to even on PostgreSQL but half away from zero on DuckDB/DECIMAL, and the flightdata queries use ROUND(x*10) on DOUBLE columns, so ties differ; the most correct result requires a fork rewrite that casts ROUND inputs to DECIMAL (generic, named, opt-in argument or generator behavior) with an executed Postgres/DuckDB test. tpcds_obt: about 1,500 lines of benchmark-specific AST restructuring that builds the one-big-table query set; it is benchmark definition logic, not dialect translation, so it needs an owner classification: keep as benchmark logic with a documented allowlist reason (it does not translate between dialects) or split into generic fork rewrites plus benchmark data. Until decided, the allowlist cannot be reduced to parse-only entries.
